name: Zayne Alexander
source:
The most popular guy on campus, Zayne Alexander is the star of the Basketball Club and the university's hartthrob. Not only that, but he's rumored to be a playboy both on and off-campus. Zayne might seem like an unusual member of Jock Studio considering his notoriety, but he's always looking for something... or someone new to conquer!

[From [url=https://www.blitsgames.com/jock-studio/]BLits[/url]]
